claims.claim: The implementation validates suite confinement, split leakage, artifact hashes, complete per-trial coverage, and adjudication metadata.

The implementation exports gold-blind annotation packs, rejects incomplete or non-independent labels, requires third-party resolution for disagreements, preserves adjudication traces, and emits review-to-meta-harness repair targets.

The implementation rejects undersized, duplicate, or mutation-incompatible confirmatory sources; derives opaque base identities from source hashes; emits held-out clean-plus-nine recipes; and keeps every pre-adjudication label and paper-eligibility state provisional.

The implementation exports clean/mutated audit pairs without promotion labels, requires two independent full-coverage isolation audits, blocks on confounds or integrity failures, binds reports to suite and artifact hashes, separates declared auditor roles, and feeds repair targets to review and the meta-harness.
On the synthetic development suite, the fail-closed audit had zero false promotions and the advisory audit had a concern-acceptance conflict rate of one.
Before strengthening, the artifact audit missed repeated-run provenance, budget mismatch, and stale-state cases and routed them to run_experiments and review.
Fail-closed promotion governance generalizes to independently curated research bundles and real manuscript-only reviewers.
